title: Bible in a Year
note: Each day has four readings: a longer Old Testament reading in whole chapters (including most of the Apocrypha and Pseudepigrapha, in this Bible’s book order), about one psalm, a couple of verses of Proverbs, and about one New Testament chapter. After Revelation, the New Testament stream continues with Odes of Solomon, Ascension of Isaiah, 4 Baruch, 4 Maccabees, Joseph and Aseneth, the Letter of Aristeas, Psalms of Solomon, and Psalms 152–155, so that stream also fills the year. The 150 psalms are read through twice; a very long psalm such as Psalm 119 is split by stanza. On February 29 in a leap year, read the February 28 portion again, or use the day to catch up. The plan finishes on December 31.
